{{Quote|Our scouts have verified that two enemy fortresses commanded by alien Sith were destroyed. This is no bluff.|Satele Shan|<ref name="TOR:TRR" />}}
The '''fortress''' of an [[Unidentified alien Sith|alien Sith]] was [[Destruction of a Sith fortress|destroyed]] by the ''[[Red Reaper]]'', the flagship of the xenophobic [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ikoral]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
